name: PT Menteng Heritage Realty Tbk
summary: PT Menteng Heritage Realty Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, owns and operates hotels in Indonesia. The company owns The Hermitage, a hotel located in Menteng, Central Jakarta. It is also involved in investment; and sea transportation businesses, as well as provides barge charter services. The company was formerly known as PT Citra Prestasi Abadi and changed its name to PT Menteng Heritage Realty Tbk in October 2007. PT Menteng Heritage Realty Tbk was founded in 2007 and is based in Jakarta Pusat, Indonesia. PT Menteng Heritage Realty Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Wijaya Wisesa Realty.
